analysis_name: RCTs: Perioperative SGLT2 inhibitors and 7-day AKI (Primary)
time_window: Postoperative day 0–7 (accept 120 h as within 7 days)
effect_measure: Risk ratio (log scale; use reported RR or compute from 2×2)
why_poolable: All are RCTs of perioperative SGLT2i with early postoperative AKI endpoints within 5–7 days and comparable definitions.
important_caveats: Exposure regimens differ (chronic preop with 72 h hold vs 1–3-day periop dosing) | One trial reports only RR without raw counts (SCR_000098) | One trial uses composite KDIGO/AKIN/RIFLE definition (SCR_000012)

analysis_name: Observational cohorts: Preop SGLT2i and 7-day AKI (Adjusted effects)
effect_measure: Generic inverse variance (log RR/OR as reported)
why_poolable: All examine early AKI with adjustment methods; provides triangulating evidence separate from trials.
important_caveats: Effect measures differ (RR vs OR); consider separate pooling or transformation if feasible | SCR_000113 assesses AKI within 48 h after OPCABG (shorter window) | Residual confounding and selection effects despite adjustment

why_poolable: These trials initiated SGLT2i in the immediate perioperative window (±3 days of surgery) and continued through POD2–5.
important_caveats: SCR_000098 withheld on day of surgery then resumed; timing differs slightly | Heterogeneity in surgery mix and CPB use

analysis_name: Exploratory (Observational): Very-early AKI within 48 hours after OPCABG
why_poolable: Single large PSM cohort with a consistent early time window.
important_caveats: Single study; different window than 7-day analyses | Off-pump CABG only—limited generalizability

analysis_name: Narrative only: Postoperative ketoacidosis/eDKA (biochemically confirmed, early window)
why_poolable: Not poolable due to widely differing definitions, ascertainment, and zero-event patterns; narrative comparison recommended.
important_caveats: Heterogeneous definitions and sampling schedules | Detection bias likely; some cohorts used systematic sampling, others symptom-triggered only
